newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA RAND STRENGTHENING, BONDS WEAKER,IN RANGE.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA RAND STRENGTHENING, BONDS WEAKER,IN RANGE.

text.p: 1245 GMT - South African rand strengthening versus dollar, while bonds gyrating in weaker range.
* Rand last at 4.4565/4595 from Tuesday's late level of 4.4640/4670. Dealers say unit drifting up on very light two-way action.
* Unit seen trading out afternoon in range of 4.4550 and 4.4700 rand to the dollar.

* Key R150 bond at 14.910 percent from previous 14.865 percent with afternoon range pegged at 14.82-14.92 percent. Dealers say some trading bank demand for long bond protecting it from break above 14.92 percent.
